items.title: 德国数字化部长疑用AI写公文遭质疑
items.raw_excerpt: 德国数字化和国家现代化部长卡斯滕·维尔德贝格尔因疑使用人工智能（AI）工具完成演讲稿等多份公文，眼下遭到德国媒体和公众质疑。据德国《时代》周报13日报道，基于专门检测AI生成内容的软件进行的分析，多篇署名维尔德贝格尔的演讲稿和评论文章似乎主要由AI生成。报道说，以维尔德贝格尔的名义发表在德国主要报纸上的文章，以及多篇议会演讲，都显示出大量由AI辅助的迹象；其2024年在美国智库大西洋理事会发表的一篇演讲据信完全由AI生成。不过，一些专家指出，此类检测软件并不完全可信。数字化和国家现代化部一名发言人向德新社证实，维尔德贝格尔将AI作为辅助工作工具使用，称这一做法缘于“他坚信德国必须迅速学会以既高效又审慎的方式使用人工智能。这适用于经济、公共部门和政治领域”。

title_i18n.zh: 德国数字化部长疑用AI写公文遭质疑
title_i18n.en: Germany's Minister for Digitalization suspected of using AI to write official documents, facing scrutiny.
title_i18n.es: El ministro de Digitalización de Alemania es cuestionado por presuntamente usar IA para redactar documentos oficiales.

excerpt_i18n.en: German Minister for Digitalization and State Modernization, Carsten Wildberger, is facing scrutiny from German media and the public over suspicions that he used artificial intelligence (AI) tools to complete multiple official documents, including speeches. According to a report by the German weekly *Die Zeit* on the 13th, analysis based on software specifically designed to detect AI-generated content suggests that several speeches and commentary articles attributed to Wildberger appear to have been primarily generated by AI. The report stated that articles published in major German newspapers under Wildberger's name, as well as multiple parliamentary speeches, show significant signs of AI assistance. One speech delivered in 2024 at the U.S. think tank Atlantic Council is believed to have been entirely generated by AI. However, some experts have pointed out that such detection software is not entirely reliable. A spokesperson for the Ministry of Digitalization and State Modernization confirmed to the German Press Agency (dpa) that Wildberger uses AI as an auxiliary work tool, stating that this approach stems from "his firm belief that Germany must quickly learn to use artificial intelligence in both an efficient and prudent manner. This applies to the economy, the public sector, and politics."
excerpt_i18n.es: El ministro alemán de Digitalización y Modernización del Estado, Carsten Wildberger, está siendo cuestionado por los medios y el público alemán tras sospechas de haber utilizado herramientas de inteligencia artificial (IA) para redactar múltiples documentos oficiales, incluidos discursos. Según informó el semanario alemán *Die Zeit* el día 13, basándose en análisis realizados con software especializado en detectar contenido generado por IA, varios discursos y artículos de opinión firmados por Wildberger parecen haber sido mayoritariamente generados por IA. El informe señala que los artículos publicados en su nombre en los principales periódicos alemanes, así como varios discursos parlamentarios, muestran numerosos indicios de asistencia de IA; se cree que un discurso pronunciado en 2024 en el think tank estadounidense Atlantic Council fue completamente generado por IA. excerpt_i18n.en: This year's college entrance exam season also brought a special "test" for Xiaomi's major home appliances—undergoing evaluation by an authoritative industry expert committee on four core technologies. Recently, the China Refrigeration Society and the China Energy Conservation Association jointly organized a technology achievement appraisal meeting for Xiaomi's major home appliance series in Wuhan, Hubei. Four key technologies independently developed by Xiaomi Smart Home Appliances (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.—dynamic refrigerant regulation and virtual perception fusion, comfortable airflow delivery through outlet shape reconstruction, full-temperature-range wide-frequency high-efficiency control, and multi-agent reinforcement learning for multi-split unit energy savings—were all certified by the expert committee as reaching "internationally leading" levels. To date, Xiaomi's major home appliances have accumulated 20 key technologies recognized as "internationally leading," which have been successively integrated into various flagship products—9 in the Strong Wind Pro series, 9 in the Top Air Outlet Pro series, and 6 in the central air conditioning series—delivering users a more comfortable, intelligent, and energy-efficient experience. Strong Wind Pro Series | Dynamic Refrigerant Regulation + Full-Temperature-Range Wide-Frequency High-Efficiency Control: Rapid cooling and heating, precise temperature control, and comprehensive energy savings. Many users face these issues: returning home in midsummer to find the air conditioner slow to cool down; experiencing fluctuating room temperatures during nighttime sleep; and seeing the air conditioner become a major "power hog" on monthly electricity bills. Xiaomi's dynamic refrigerant regulation technology addresses this precisely: it dynamically and intelligently adjusts the system's refrigerant volume based on actual demand, increasing refrigerant supply during rapid cooling and heating.
excerpt_i18n.es: Este año, durante la temporada de exámenes de ingreso a la universidad, los grandes electrodomésticos de Xiaomi también se enfrentaron a una "prueba" especial: presentar cuatro tecnologías clave para ser evaluadas por un comité de expertos de la industria. Recientemente, la Asociación China de Refrigeración y la Asociación China de Conservación de Energía organizaron conjuntamente en Wuhan, Hubei, una reunión de evaluación de resultados tecnológicos de los grandes electrodomésticos de Xiaomi. items.title: A Court Has Ruled That Google Is Liable for False Statements Generated by AI Overviews
items.raw_excerpt: The ruling holds that a company that designs, trains, operates, and manages an AI system must assume legal liability for any damages caused by the responses it generates.

title_i18n.en: A Court Has Ruled That Google Is Liable for False Statements Generated by AI Overviews
title_i18n.zh: 法院裁定谷歌需为AI生成的虚假陈述承担责任。
title_i18n.es: Un tribunal ha dictaminado que Google es responsable de las declaraciones falsas generadas por los resúmenes de IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: The ruling holds that a company that designs, trains, operates, and manages an AI system must assume legal liability for any damages caused by the responses it generates.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该裁决认定，设计、训练、运营及管理人工智能系统的公司，必须对其生成回复所造成的任何损害承担法律责任。
excerpt_i18n.es: La sentencia establece que una empresa que diseña, entrena, opera y gestiona un sistema de IA debe asumir la responsabilidad legal por cualquier daño causado por las respuestas que este genere.

items.title: 2026北京智源大会开幕 | 从“悟道”到“悟界”，智源研究院推动人工智能、物理世界和生命科学“三体互动”
items.raw_excerpt: 2026年6月12日，第八届“北京智源大会”在中关村国际创新中心开幕。 北京智源大会是智源研究院主办的“AI内行学术盛会”，以“技术前沿、国际视野、青年人才”为特色，汇聚海内外研究者分享研究成果、探寻前沿知识、交流实践经验。本届大会，现代数字安全体系奠基者Whitfield Diffie线下参会，聚焦Agent时代的安全与可信挑战；强化学习奠基人Andrew Barto追问“交互驱动智能”对于下一代AI系统的意义。30余位30岁以下青年科学家，40余位AI企业CEO、创始人与首席科学家，200余位顶尖专家学者将齐聚北京，中国AI产业世界模型与Agent领域最具代表性的创新力量首次集中同台。20余家全球顶尖科技企业及高校科研机构，包括Meta、英伟达、哈佛、MIT等，将与阿里、腾讯、小米、生数科技、面壁智能、清华、北大、人大等中国AI行业最核心的 创新力量同场交流。同时，大会还汇聚数百位全球AI领域学术中坚力量，一同围绕世界模型、通用智能体、具身智能、AI安全、AI Native教育、Token经济与OPC、智能计算底层架构等前沿方向展开精彩演讲和前瞻性对话。 开幕式由智源研究院理事长黄铁军主持。 智源研究院院长王仲远做2026年研究进展报告，发布智源研究院在基座大模型、智能体、基础软硬件生态等前沿技术领域的探索成果和开源生态建设的最新动态。 自2018年成立以来，智源研究院先后发布了“悟道”系列大模型和“悟界”系列大模型，构建了自底向上的全栈大模型开源技术体系。无论是在大模型发展的早期，还是在物理AI的全新时期，智源研究院始终在引领人工智能大模型的前沿研究探索。截至目前，智源开源模型超200个，全球总下载量累计超过10亿次。同时也孵化了一系列在大模型领域和具身智能领域非常具有代表性的创新创业企业。 2024年智源大会上，智源发布了对于人工智能尤其是大模型技术的演化路径的预判

excerpt_i18n.en: On June 12, 2026, the 8th Beijing Zhiyuan Conference opened at the Zhongguancun International Innovation Center. Hosted by the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI), the conference is an "insider academic gathering for AI" featuring cutting-edge technology, global perspectives, and young talent. It brings together researchers from home and abroad to share findings, explore frontier knowledge, and exchange practical experience. This year, Whitfield Diffie, founder of modern digital security systems, attended in person to focus on security and trust challenges in the Agent era; Andrew Barto, founder of reinforcement learning, questioned the significance of "interaction-driven intelligence" for next-generation AI systems. Over 30 young scientists under 30, more than 40 AI company CEOs, founders, and chief scientists, and over 200 top experts and scholars will gather in Beijing, marking the first time China's most representative innovative forces in world models and Agent fields take the stage together. More than 20 global leading tech companies and university research institutions, including Meta, Nvidia, Harvard, and MIT, will exchange ideas with core Chinese AI innovators such as Alibaba, Tencent, Xiaomi, Shengshu Technology, Mianbi Intelligence, Tsinghua University, Peking University, and Renmin University. Additionally, the conference brings together hundreds of global AI academic leaders for exciting speeches and forward-looking dialogues on frontier topics like world models, general agents, embodied intelligence, AI safety, AI-native education, token economy and OPC, and intelligent computing infrastructure. The opening ceremony was chaired by Huang
excerpt_i18n.es: El 12 de junio de 2026, la octava edición de la "Conferencia Beijing BAAI" se inauguró en el Centro Internacional de Innovación de Zhongguancun. La Conferencia Beijing BAAI es un "encuentro académico para expertos en IA" organizado por el Instituto de Investigación BAAI, caracterizado por "fronteras tecnológicas, perspectiva internacional y talento joven", reuniendo a investigadores nacionales e internacionales para compartir resultados de investigación, explorar conocimientos de vanguardia e intercambiar experiencias prácticas. En esta edición, Whitfield Diffie, fundador del sistema moderno de seguridad digital, asistió presencialmente, centrándose en los desafíos de seguridad y confianza en la era de los agentes; Andrew Barto, pionero del aprendizaje por refuerzo, cuestionó el significado de la "inteligencia impulsada por la interacción" para los sistemas de IA de próxima generación. Más de 30 jóvenes menores de 30 años.
